from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class TotalLiabilityEntry(BaseModel):
    """Total Current Liabilities figure from one document, including any prior-year baseline provided."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company the filing belongs to")
    year: int | None = Field(description="The fiscal year this entry represents")
    total_current_liabilities: float | None = Field(description="Total Current Liabilities value for this year, in dollars")
    prior_year_value: float | None = Field(description="Total Current Liabilities from the prior year, if disclosed in this document")
    prior_year: int | None = Field(description="The year of the prior_year_value, if present")
    source_document: str | None = Field(description="Which filing/document this data came from")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    liability_entries: list[TotalLiabilityEntry]
